faqs.question: Who can buy Senior Citizen Health Insurance?
faqs.answer: Individuals aged 60 years and above are generally eligible.

faqs.question: Does it cover pre-existing diseases?
faqs.answer: Coverage is usually available after the specified waiting period.

faqs.question: Is medical screening required?
faqs.answer: Some insurers may require health checkups before policy issuance.

faqs.question: Does it cover hospitalization?
faqs.answer: Yes, hospitalization expenses are covered according to policy terms.
